# frozen_string_literal: true
require 'prawn'
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'
require 'digest'
require 'unicode_utils'

module SecurePDF
  class DocumentGenerator
    ALLOWED_FONTS = ['Helvetica', 'Times-Roman', 'Courier'].freeze
    ENCRYPTION_ALGO = 'aes-256-gcm'
    CONFUSABLE_MAP = load_confusables_map

    def initialize(encryption_key:, storage_path:, kdf_salt:)
      # kdf_salt must be a unique, sufficiently long random value supplied and
      # persisted by the caller (do NOT hardcode a static salt).
      raise ArgumentError, "kdf_salt required" if kdf_salt.nil? || kdf_salt.bytesize < 16
      @kdf_salt = kdf_salt
      @encryption_key = derive_key(encryption_key)
      @storage_path = File.expand_path(storage_path)
      @audit_log = []
    end

    def generate_certificate(recipient_name:, issuer:, template: :standard)
      sanitized_name = sanitize_display_name(recipient_name)
      sanitized_issuer = sanitize_display_name(issuer)

      pdf_content = render_pdf(sanitized_name, sanitized_issuer, template)
      encrypted_blob = encrypt_document(pdf_content)

      filename = generate_safe_filename(sanitized_name)
      store_document(filename, encrypted_blob)

      log_generation(sanitized_name, sanitized_issuer, filename)
      { filename: filename, checksum: compute_checksum(encrypted_blob) }
    end

    private

    def self.load_confusables_map
      # Subset of Unicode confusables for Latin script
      {
        "\u0410" => "A", # Cyrillic A
        "\u0412" => "B", # Cyrillic Ve
        "\u0421" => "C", # Cyrillic Es
        "\u0415" => "E", # Cyrillic Ie
        "\u041D" => "H", # Cyrillic En
        "\u041A" => "K", # Cyrillic Ka
        "\u041C" => "M", # Cyrillic Em
        "\u041E" => "O", # Cyrillic O
        "\u0420" => "P", # Cyrillic Er
        "\u0422" => "T", # Cyrillic Te
        "\u0425" => "X", # Cyrillic Kha
        "\u0430" => "a", # Cyrillic a
        "\u0435" => "e", # Cyrillic ie
        "\u043E" => "o", # Cyrillic o
        "\u0440" => "p", # Cyrillic er
        "\u0441" => "c", # Cyrillic es
        "\u0443" => "y", # Cyrillic u
        "\u0445" => "x", # Cyrillic kha
      }
    end

    def sanitize_display_name(name)
      # Step 1: NFC normalization
      normalized = name.unicode_normalize(:nfc)

      # Step 2: Strip control characters and zero-width chars
      cleaned = normalized.gsub(/[\u200B-\u200F\u202A-\u202E\uFEFF\u0000-\u001F]/, '')

      # Step 3: Normalize confusables BEFORE script detection
      deconfused = normalize_confusables(cleaned)

      # Step 4: Detect mixed scripts (homograph protection)
      unless single_script?(deconfused)
        raise SecurityError, "Mixed script content detected in: #{cleaned.inspect}"
      end

      # Step 5: Length validation
      raise ArgumentError, "Name too long" if deconfused.length > 128
      raise ArgumentError, "Name too short" if deconfused.length < 1

      deconfused
    end

    def normalize_confusables(text)
      text.each_char.map { |c|
        CONFUSABLE_MAP[c] || c
      }.join
    end

    def single_script?(text)
      scripts = text.each_char.map { |c| detect_script(c) }.uniq
      scripts -= [:common, :inherited]
      scripts.length <= 1
    end

    def detect_script(char)
      codepoint = char.ord
      case codepoint
      when 0x0000..0x007F then :latin   # Basic Latin
      when 0x0080..0x00FF then :latin   # Latin-1 Supplement
      when 0x0100..0x024F then :latin   # Latin Extended
      when 0x0250..0x02AF then :latin   # IPA Extensions
      when 0x0370..0x03FF then :greek
      when 0x0400..0x04FF then :cyrillic
      when 0x0500..0x052F then :cyrillic
      when 0x0020..0x002F, 0x003A..0x0040, 0x005B..0x0060, 0x007B..0x007E
        :common  # Punctuation and symbols
      when 0x0030..0x0039 then :common  # Digits
      else :other
      end
    end

    def render_pdf(name, issuer, template)
      Prawn::Document.new(page_size: 'A4') do |pdf|
        pdf.font('Helvetica')
        pdf.text "Certificate of Completion", size: 24, align: :center
        pdf.move_down 40
        pdf.text "This certifies that", size: 14, align: :center
        pdf.move_down 20
        pdf.text name, size: 20, align: :center, style: :bold
        pdf.move_down 20
        pdf.text "has successfully completed the requirements.", size: 14, align: :center
        pdf.move_down 40
        pdf.text "Issued by: #{issuer}", size: 12, align: :center
        pdf.text "Date: #{Time.now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}", size: 12, align: :center
      end.render
    end

    def encrypt_document(content)
      cipher = OpenSSL::Cipher.new(ENCRYPTION_ALGO)
      cipher.encrypt
      cipher.key = @encryption_key
      iv = cipher.random_iv
      cipher.auth_data = 'securepdf-v1'

      encrypted = cipher.update(content) + cipher.final
      tag = cipher.auth_tag

      Base64.strict_encode64(iv + tag + encrypted)
    end

    def generate_safe_filename(name)
      # Use skeleton comparison for filename deduplication
      skeleton = compute_skeleton(name)
      hash = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(skeleton)[0..15]
      "cert_#{hash}_#{Time.now.to_i}.enc"
    end

    def compute_skeleton(text)
      # Map confusables to their canonical form for comparison
      text.each_char.map { |c|
        CONFUSABLE_MAP[c] || c
      }.join.downcase
    end

    def store_document(filename, blob)
      # Only allow a bare basename with no path separators or traversal segments.
      basename = File.basename(filename)
      if basename != filename || filename.include?('..') || filename.include?('/') || filename.include?("\\")
        raise SecurityError, "Invalid filename"
      end

      full_path = File.expand_path(File.join(@storage_path, basename))

      # Ensure the resolved path is strictly contained within the storage dir.
      storage_prefix = @storage_path.end_with?(File::SEPARATOR) ? @storage_path : "#{@storage_path}#{File::SEPARATOR}"
      unless full_path.start_with?(storage_prefix)
        raise SecurityError, "Path traversal detected"
      end

      File.write(full_path, blob, mode: 'wb')
    end

    def derive_key(passphrase)
      OpenSSL::KDF.pbkdf2_hmac(
        passphrase,
        salt: @kdf_salt,
        iterations: 100_000,
        length: 32,
        hash: 'sha256'
      )
    end

    def compute_checksum(data)
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(data)
    end

    def log_generation(name, issuer, filename)
      @audit_log << {
        timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601,
        recipient: name,
        issuer: issuer,
        file: filename
      }
    end
  end
end
